what: The NVIDIA timing rows, first cut on compute capability 8.6 and portable to any certified NVIDIA GPU (cert8.py --architecture <the device's compute capability>): the identical-case ladder of pml_3d and the three cases the extended ladder adds (pml_3d_lorentz, dispersive; pml_3d_monitors, monitor-heavy; pml_3d_hz, a source on a fused seam) at the three sizes of record, both routes, three passes, with the MEEP controls, the hybrid MPI x OpenMP rows as reference legs (H6 fixed) and the labelled context legs the site names; and the fused-product rows the dispatch-preference records are cut from (every DRIVE case the release dispatches, and the size sweep).

ladder.binding: bound is the 1.0 binding probe's choice on this host type; a new host runs the probe once (timing_ladder.py --tiers bindprobe) and its catalog names the binding chosen
ladder.context: the context legs (--controls context) are named by the SITE, never here: --context-meep ctx-native=<python>,<mpirun>,<build record> and --context-meep ctx-cfdouble=<python>,<mpiexec>,<build record> in the --ladder-params file; without them the control is omitted by name
ladder.notes: --threaded-reference 1 makes the threads2/threads4 rows reference legs, so MEEP's best (the denominator) may be hybrid MPI x OpenMP; --leave-free-share 0.25 leaves a quarter of the CPUs free on a shared host (the 2P bound-hwthread row is not planned); preference_routes run only with cert8.py --preference-legs
